```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
import { require_value } from "./value.mjs";

var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/esm_ensure_chunk
(() => {
__webpack_require__.f = {};
__webpack_require__.e = function(chunkId, fetchPriority) {
	return Promise.all(Object.keys(__webpack_require__.f).reduce(function(promises, key) {
		__webpack_require__.f[key](chunkId, promises, fetchPriority);
		return promises;
	}, []));
};

})();
// webpack/runtime/esm_chunk_loading
(() => {
var esmInstalledChunks = {};
var esmChunkMap = {
"value": function() { return import("./value.mjs"); }
};
__webpack_require__.f.j = function(chunkId, promises) {
	var installedChunkData = esmInstalledChunks[chunkId];
	if(installedChunkData === 0) return;
	if(installedChunkData) {
		promises.push(installedChunkData);
		return;
	}
	var loadChunk = esmChunkMap[chunkId];
	if(!loadChunk) return;
	var promise = loadChunk().then(function() {
		esmInstalledChunks[chunkId] = 0;
	}, function(error) {
		delete esmInstalledChunks[chunkId];
		throw error;
	});
	esmInstalledChunks[chunkId] = promise;
	promises.push(promise);
};

})();

export { __webpack_require__ };
```
